What is the disclosure-avoidance noise parameter (privacy-loss budget) on the share of the people privacy-loss budget (rho) allocated to the state geographic level in the P.L. 94-171 redistricting data?
response_text:
**1,440/4,099** — about 35.1% of the people privacy-loss budget.

The state level receives the largest single share of any geographic level in the P.L. 94-171 allocation. In absolute terms that works out to roughly ρ ≈ 0.899 of the global ρ = 2.56 (1,440/4,099 × 2.56 = 0.8993).

For context, the full allocation ranks: state (1,440/4,099) > optimized block group (1,256/4,099) > tract (687/4,099) > county (447/4,099) > block (165/4,099) > United States (104/4,099).
